name: Bridge Data Centres QHI01 (Khlong Tamru)
notes: 0.2 GW (200 MW) hyperscale facility under construction in Khlong Tamru subdistrict, Chonburi (Mongabay, Dec 2025 site visit). Locals say it will host Google and TikTok servers. BDC secured USD 2.8bn bank financing for Thai/Malaysian build-out; 10-year water supply agreement with Eastwater Stecon Utilities (EWS) for ~3.3M m3/yr. Would be one of the most powerful facilities in the province.

name: Google Chonburi Data Center (Quartz Computing)
notes: Google confirmed building a data center in Chonburi (~100 jobs once operational); EIA conducted but findings not shared. BOI approved 32.8bn baht hyperscale data center by Quartz Computing (Alphabet subsidiary) in Chonburi. Baxtel notes Google's first Thailand data center is in a WHA industrial estate within the EEC in Chonburi. AI Data Center Index lists 100 MW planned. Construction observed in Dec 2025.

name: DayOne Chonburi Tech Park (CTP1 & CTP2)
notes: DayOne (GDS International's overseas platform) announced entry into Thailand Nov 2024 with a hyperscale campus in Chonburi. Chonburi Tech Park has two sites (CTP1 & CTP2), 300 MW CTP1 capacity, RFS 2026, building toward Thailand's first 1GW power platform. GDS International plans up to USD 1bn hyperscale datacentre park in Chonburi.

name: GSA02 (Gulf-Singtel-AIS) Chonburi Data Center
notes: GSA allocating 13.5bn baht to build a data centre with 35 MW IT load in Chon Buri; with this, GSA capacity will reach 90 MW (50 MW in Samut Prakan). GSA became the first Thai data center to deploy/activate NVIDIA GB200 systems. GSA02 listed on gsa-dc.com as Chonburi, Thailand.

name: True Internet Data Center (True IDC) Chonburi projects
developer: True Internet Data Center Co., Ltd.
notes: Three data center projects approved at BOI's first 2026 board meeting with total investment ~USD 1.4bn (THB 45.3bn) and combined IT load of 223 MW, located in Chonburi and Samut Prakan. Chonburi-specific split of the 223 MW not published. Part of 7 data centre approvals worth >USD 3.1bn (THB 96.88bn) in Jan 2026.

name: Digital Edge x B.Grimm Power Chonburi Campus
developer: Digital Edge DC (JV with B.Grimm Power)
notes: Digital Edge and B.Grimm Power (BGRIM) broke ground on a 100 MW AI-ready data center campus in Chonburi (some reports list 96 MW; USD 750m). Commercial operations expected Q4 2026 per Bangkok Post. Part of Thailand's EEC data center boom.

name: Vistas Technology Amata City Chonburi Data Center
developer: Vistas Technology (subsidiary of ZDATA Technologies, China)
notes: Vistas Technology to invest THB 9.9bn (~USD 306m) to construct an 80 MW facility in the Amata City Chonburi Industrial Estate; second BOI-approved project for the company.

name: Bridge Data Centres III (Thailand)
notes: BOI approval for 14.45bn baht data center project with ~80 MW IT load located in Chonburi Province; one of six Tier 3 data centers approved in 1H2025 per trade reports.

name: Bridge Data Centres IIO (Thailand)
notes: Bridge Data Centres IIO (Thailand) Co., Ltd. approved with investment of 24.6bn baht (USD 746m), located in Chonburi, supporting 134 MW IT load; part of the May 2026 BOI approval wave (~THB 958bn across six projects).

name: China Mobile / SUPERNAP Thailand (Bangkok I, Bo Win)
notes: Facility in Bo Win, Chonburi (short code Bangkok I), built 2017, Uptime Institute Tier IV design, target PUE 1.35-1.45. China Mobile completed acquisition of SUPERNAP Thailand on 18 Mar 2025. Located near Laem Chabang deep sea port and planned submarine-cable/Ultra High Broadband hub. No public MW figure.

name: National Telecom (NT) Sriracha Data Center
notes: Data center facility in Sriracha, Chonburi listed on Baxtel's Thailand directory (near China Mobile Chon Buri site). No public capacity/details located.

name: CtrlS Chon Buri (EECd / Digital Park Thailand)
notes: CtrlS secured a 50-year lease for a 10-acre plot in the Eastern Economic Corridor of Digital (EECd / Digital Park Thailand), which is located in Laem Chabang sub-district, Sriracha district, Chonburi province, for data center development. No capacity published yet.

name: Keppel DC Chon Buri expansion
notes: Baxtel lists Keppel DC expanding its data center footprint in Chonburi Province on 15 hectares of land, including 6 hectares acquired in Q3 2025 (entry spans Chon Buri and Rayong). No capacity published.

name: Doma Infrastructure Group Chonburi Data Center Park
developer: Doma Infrastructure Group + Silicon Tech Park (STP)
notes: One of three AI-ready green data centre parks (Chachoengsao, Chonburi, Rayong) developed by Doma Infrastructure Group (DIG) with STP; JV plans ~300 acres across the three provinces with combined 1.5 GW power capacity; Chonburi parcel planned from 2027; first phase service-ready Q3 2026.

name: Galaxy Data Center (GDC) 1GW Hyperscale (Silicon Tech Park)
notes: China-based Galaxy Data Center announced ~USD 2bn investment in Thailand; planned 1 GW hyperscale facility in Silicon Tech Park, Ban Chang district, Rayong ('Southeast Asia's premier Data Center Valley'); BOI-related project value reported ~USD 690m. Water demand for this and a second STP facility projected at 19,600-28,600 m3/day.

name: Beijing Haoyang Rayong Campus
developer: Beijing Haoyang Cloud&Data Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Beijing Haoyang's first international data center: 300 MW (0.3 GW) site in Rayong, BOI-approved at ~USD 2.2bn, described as among the largest of its kind in Southeast Asia. Land purchase reported by DCD.

name: Stratus Technology / ZData Technologies Rayong
notes: BOI-approved data center project in Rayong Province: 23.7bn baht (~USD 727m), ~200 MW IT load (reported as 203 MW Tier 3); trade press refers to the entity variously as Stratus Technology Co and ZData Technologies (0.2 GW project). Vistas Technology (also ZDATA group) is a separate Amata City Chonburi project.

name: EEC Global Cloud DC1
notes: EEC Global Cloud's DC1 Data Center located in Rayong, Thailand, per Baxtel directory (planned). No capacity or timeline published.

name: GSA05 Rayong (WHA Eastern Seaboard Industrial Estate 5)
developer: GSA Data Center (GULF / Singtel / AIS JV)
notes: GSA Data Center 05 Co., Ltd.: two projects totalling ~USD 1.2bn (THB 37.2bn) with combined IT load of 120 MW, located at WHA Eastern Seaboard Industrial Estate 5 (Rayong) and in Samut Prakan. Rayong-specific MW share not published.

name: Freyr Technology (Thailand) Rayong data hosting
notes: Singapore-based Freyr Technology received BOI approval (Jan 2026) for a 6.32bn baht (~USD 200m) data hosting project with facilities located in Rayong and Samut Prakan; part of Thailand's push to become a regional AI hub.

name: Amazon Web Services Thailand Region data centers (x2)
notes: Mongabay (Mar 2026) reports Rayong already home to at least three data centers, including two run by Amazon (AWS Thailand Region ap-southeast-7 launched Jan 2025). Data Center Map lists the facilities (BKK-TA-SIT and BKK-MAENAM-KHU-MAI) under the Pattaya/Chonburi area; province attribution ambiguous between Chon Buri and Rayong - recorded here per Mongabay. No public MW per facility.

name: Planet Communications Asia Data Center (STP Planet DC)
notes: Identified by Mongabay as one of three already-operating data centers in Rayong (with two Amazon facilities). Operator page stpplanetdc.com (STP - Silicon Tech Park related). No public MW capacity found.

name: K2 Strategic Rayong facilities (x2)
notes: A pair of data center facilities totalling 0.05 GW (50 MW) planned in Rayong per Mongabay's catalog of the Rayong data center pipeline (alongside Galaxy 1GW and Haoyang 0.3GW).

name: Doma: Rayong Data Center Park
developer: Doma Infrastructure Group + Silicon Tech Park (STP)
notes: Part of Doma Infrastructure Group's (DIG) AI-ready green data center parks in the EEC (with STP); Rayong parcel planned from 2027; combined 1.5 GW across the three EEC parks (Chachoengsao, Chonburi, Rayong).

name: TikTok System (Thailand) data center expansion
developer: TikTok Pte. Ltd. / ByteDance (TikTok System (Thailand) Co., Ltd.)
notes: BOI approved (6 May 2026) a THB 842bn (~USD 25bn) data-centre expansion covering server installation, data-storage and processing capacity across Bangkok, Samut Prakan and Chachoengsao. Follows earlier commitments: USD 3.8bn approved Jan 2025 and USD 8.8bn over five years announced Feb 2025. TNW calls Chachoengsao Thailand's primary data-centre cluster. No MW split published.

name: Skyline Data Center and Cloud Services (DAMAC Group)
developer: Skyline Data Center and Cloud Services Co., Ltd. (DAMAC Group, UAE)
notes: THB 46bn (~USD 1.4bn) data center investment by Skyline Data Center and Cloud Services (DAMAC Group unit, related to Edgnex/DAMAC Digital) located in Chachoengsao, supporting 200 MW IT load; approved in the May 2026 BOI wave.

name: Digital Meteor Chachoengsao Data Center
notes: Digital Meteor's inaugural project: Chachoengsao Data Center within the EEC, citing Bang Pakong power plant proximity and planned Chachoengsao gas-fired plant. No capacity or timeline published on company site.

name: Doma Infrastructure Group Chachoengsao Data Center Park
developer: Doma Infrastructure Group + Silicon Tech Park (STP)
notes: Chachoengsao is one of three provinces hosting Doma/STP AI-ready green data centre parks (300 acres combined, 1.5 GW total across Chachoengsao, Chonburi, Rayong); first phase Q3 2026. TNW also notes Chachoengsao has become Thailand's primary data-centre cluster with earlier hyperscaler approvals (AWS, Google, NextDC, CtrlS, GDS reported).
